name: Sweet & Sour Shrimp with Rice Noodles, Carrots and Peppers

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with water and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions. Then drain in a colander and rinse.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium carrots
1 red bell pepper
1 stick celery
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ medium head napa cabbage
1 lime
1 orange

instructions.primary_message: Peel the carrots; then using the peeler, run it along the carrot to make long, noodle-like strips. Seed and slice bell pepper into thin strips. Trim ends of celery and slice into small pieces. Transfer all to a medium bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into small pieces. Add half of the onions to the bowl with the sliced vegetables (reserving the rest for garnish).
Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Peel and mince the garlic.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the sliced vegetables, ginger, garlic, and black pepper to the pot. Sauté until soft, 4-5 minutes.
Trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Add the cabbage and shrimp to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cabbage softens and shrimp is cooked through, 2-3 minutes.
Juice the lime into a small bowl. Add the cornstarch and whisk together.

Juice the orange into the pot; add broth, sugar, soy sauce, and fish sauce. Bring to a boil over high heat, then stir in the cornstarch mixture. Reduce heat to low, add rice noodles, and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 fl oz (½ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp fish sauce

instructions.primary_message: Divide between bowls, garnish with remaining green onion, and enjoy!
